svg.title: How the mean, median, variance and MAD respond to a contaminating component
svg.desc: Left: as the contaminating component moves right, the mean rises without limit while the median flattens out near 0.066. Right: the variance grows like a parabola while the MAD-based scale stays near one.
svg.text: One part in twenty is somewhere else: what each summary does about it
the sample is 95 percent standard normal and 5 percent centred at the marked position
mean: a straight line of slope 0.05,
median: flat at plus or minus 0.0660
however far out the contamination sits
squared MAD scale, flat near 1.13, against a target of 1
A bounded influence curve is the whole difference. Move the contamination further out and the mean and the variance
change without limit, while the median and the MAD stop responding once it has cleared the bulk of the data.
